description: This file defines the API and data structures for managing submodule configurations in a Git repository, including functions for lookup, parsing, and cache management related to submodules.

classes.name: submodule
classes.description: Represents a Git submodule with its configuration details such as path, URL, branch, and update strategy.

classes.name: submodule_tree_entry
classes.description: Contains information about a submodule within a specific tree, including its repository and configuration.

classes.name: submodule_entry_list
classes.description: A list structure holding multiple submodule_tree_entry items.

methods.name: submodule_cache_free
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a submodule cache.

methods.name: submodule_from_name
methods.description: Retrieves a submodule by name from a repository at a specific commit or tree.

methods.name: submodule_from_path
methods.description: Retrieves a submodule by path from a repository at a specific commit or tree.

methods.name: submodule_free
methods.description: Frees cached submodule data for a repository.

methods.name: submodules_of_tree
methods.description: Returns all submodules within a given tree, excluding nested submodules.
